_doc: SWORN SKILLS - built by tools/build_sworn_skills.py from tools/wave4/sworn_skills.json. Do not edit here; edit the source and rebuild.

adrian_templar.from: Wave 4: 'he stops holding the line and spreads it, so the whole party shares the damage he'd have taken. It's about letting other people carry some of it.'

ability.name: Let Them Carry Some of It
ability.engine: live: damage_share spread (new 19 Nov 2026) - a share of each hit on him is split across the party, cut on the way
ability.description: For 4 turns, 60% of every hit on Adrián is split evenly across the rest of the party, and they take 30% less of it than he would have.

alonso_pyromancer.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the word he couldn't say. ... he brings the whole fight up to firing heat for a few turns, and every fire spell in the party hits harder.'

ability.name: Up to Firing Heat
ability.engine: live: all_enemies debuff fire_damage_taken_pct +40 for 4 turns (monster take_damage reads <school>_damage_taken_pct)
ability.description: Alonso brings the whole fight up to firing heat. For 4 turns every enemy takes 40% more fire damage, from anyone in the party.

ama_priest.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is being unable to stop. ... a passive where she heals less when the party is safe and more when it isn't, because she's finally letting herself rest.'

passives._text: Ama's heals land 40% harder on an ally below half health, and 20% softer on one above 80%.

amber_druid.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is the fear of running out of time. ... a passive where her heals over time grow stronger the longer they run.'

passives._text: Every heal over time Amber casts heals 15% more with each turn it keeps running.

anjali_druid.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is the fear of her work being lost. ... a passive where her heals leave a slow, lasting growth on the target that keeps healing.'

passives._text: Every direct heal Anjali casts leaves a slow growth on whoever it lands on, healing them for a further 10% of that heal each turn for 4 turns.

astrid_starcaller.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is fearing the sky will never surprise her. ... she calls down an aurora that dazzles every enemy and makes them easier to hit.'

ability.name: The Sky Surprises Her
ability.engine: live: all_enemies debuff sure_target (the party can't miss them) and miss_chance_pct 20, 3 turns
ability.description: Astrid calls down an aurora. For 3 turns every enemy is dazzled: they miss 20% of their attacks, and nobody's attacks on them can miss.

bakyt_hunter.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the end of six generations. ... his eagle marks every enemy's weak point, and the party's attacks on them hit harder.'

ability.name: The Eagle Sees Every Weak Point
ability.engine: live: all_enemies debuff for 4 turns, physical and magic damage taken +20 and armour -25%
ability.description: Bakyt's eagle marks every enemy's weak point. For 4 turns every enemy takes 20% more damage and has 25% less armour.

bashir_witchhunter.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the unfinished sentence. ... he marks a line, and corrupted enemies that cross it take heavy holy damage.'

ability.name: The Line Holds
ability.engine: live: trap on one enemy row, holy; creature_bonus +100% against undead and demons
ability.description: Bashir snaps a chalk line across one enemy row. The first enemy in it to act takes heavy holy damage, and an undead or demon takes double.

berat_tinker.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is never stopping to feel it. ... he gets everyone talking and laughing so the whole party shakes off fear and stuns.'

ability.name: Everybody Laughing at Once
ability.engine: live: party cc_immune for 4 turns (it also breaks stuns already on them) and +15% damage
ability.description: Berat gets the whole party talking and laughing. Anyone stunned or frightened shakes it off, and for 4 turns nobody can be stunned, feared or charmed, and everyone deals 15% more damage.

bruno_templar.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the night of the camp. ... a flurry of holy punches that strikes one enemy several times and heals the party with each hit.'

ability.name: The Whole Round
ability.engine: live: four strikes on one enemy (repeat_hits 4), holy; each heals every ally for 15% of it (heals_party_pct_of_damage)
ability.description: Bruno throws a flurry of four holy punches at one enemy. Every punch heals each ally for 15% of the damage it did.

callum_venomancer.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the serpent he had to kill. ... he takes every poison on the party into himself and shrugs it off.'

ability.name: Into Himself, and Out Again
ability.engine: live: cleanses every poison and disease off each ally, then a party dot_immune buff for 3 turns
ability.description: Callum draws every poison and disease off the party and shrugs it off. For 3 turns no ally takes damage from anything that hurts over time.

camila_venomancer.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is preferring scorpions to people. ... she turns every poison on the party into a heal.'

ability.name: All of It, Back
ability.engine: live: party dispel of every poison and disease, each healing for what it would still have done; heals_party_pct_max 8
ability.description: Camila takes every poison and disease off the party, and each one heals its ally for all the damage it still had to do. Every ally is healed for 8% of their maximum on top.

camille_ranger.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is the swapped shift. ... she moves so fast she acts twice, and takes an ally's next hit for them.'

ability.name: Takes the Shift
ability.engine: live: damage_share 100% to Camille for one hit (uses 1, 3 turns), and self_turn: her next turn comes at once
ability.description: Camille takes the next hit aimed at an ally, any time in the next 3 turns, and moves so fast she acts again at once.

carolina_shaman.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is wanting to belong somewhere. ... she calls the river's current through the party, washing away harmful effects and speeding everyone up.'

ability.name: Where the River Goes
ability.engine: live: party heal over time that cleanses one harmful effect each turn, with haste while it runs
ability.description: The river runs through the party. For 3 turns every ally heals each turn, loses one harmful effect each turn, and acts 25% faster.

cristobal_knight.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the grass fire, and the people he couldn't bring out. ... he walks into the worst of it and pulls the lowest-health ally out, shielding them.'

ability.name: Brings Them Out This Time
ability.engine: live: absorb on the lowest-health ally (auto_lowest_ally) with forced_back, 3 turns
ability.description: Cristóbal walks into the worst of it and brings out whoever is lowest. He shields them, and for 3 turns they stand in the back row.

dan_warrior.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is being afraid he's useless. ... the party takes less damage for every ally still standing, because a crew holds together.'

ability.name: A Crew Holds Together
ability.engine: live: party damage taken -7% per living ally (scaling living_allies, cap 5) for 4 turns; the cooldown starts when it ends. The profile's idea was a passive; built as a cast so it stays a trump card
ability.description: For 4 turns every ally takes 7% less damage for each ally still standing, Dan included, up to 35%.

delroy_witchdoctor.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the waiting by the piers. ... he hands out a brew that heals the whole party and keeps healing them for a few turns.'

ability.name: One for Everyone on the Pier
ability.engine: live: party heal over time for 4 turns, plus heals_party_pct_max 15 at once
ability.description: Delroy hands a brew to everyone. Every ally is healed for 15% of their maximum at once, and keeps healing each turn for 4 turns.

diego_tinker.from: Wave 4: 'he puts a fallen ally's broken gear right and they get back up with a shield.'

ability.name: Put It Right
ability.engine: live: revive with a shield (new 19 Nov 2026): back at 40% health with a 3-turn absorb
ability.description: Brings a fallen ally back at 40% health, with a shield that holds for 3 turns.

driss_shaman.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the years away from Nour. ... he calls a sandstorm that blinds the enemies and hides the party.'

ability.name: The Sandstorm
ability.engine: live: party dodge +20 and enemy_mods miss_chance_pct 30 for 3 turns
ability.description: Driss calls the sand up. For 3 turns every enemy misses 30% of its attacks, and every ally has 20% more dodge.

eino_barbarian.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is his stubbornness, and his brother. ... a huge felling blow that drops the biggest enemy's guard for the whole party.'

ability.name: The Felling Blow
ability.engine: live: heavy strike on the enemy with the most maximum health (auto_enemy largest); target_mods armour -50% and physical damage taken +20 for 3 turns
ability.description: Eino fells the biggest enemy in the fight, whoever was clicked. For 3 turns it has half its armour and takes 20% more physical damage from everyone.

elias_suncleric.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is putting it off. ... he raises a wall of light in front of the party, absorbing a large amount of damage.'

ability.name: Not Putting It Off
ability.engine: live: party absorb for 3 turns
ability.description: Elias stops putting it off and raises the wall now. Every ally is shielded by light for 3 turns.

elie_bloodmage.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is always saving and never arriving. ... he shares the party's health out evenly, healing the wounded from the healthy.'

ability.name: Arrives This Time
ability.engine: live: immediate even_out: every living ally to the party's average share of health, then +10% of maximum each
ability.description: Elie shares the party's health out evenly, healing the wounded from the healthy, then gives every ally 10% of their maximum on top.

emre_rogue.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the question, and the guilt of feeling light. ... he finds the weak point in an enemy's defence, and every ally ignores its armour for a turn.'

ability.name: The Door Was Always Open
ability.engine: live: debuff armor_pct -100 and physical damage taken +15 for 2 turns
ability.description: Emre finds the gap in an enemy's defence. For 2 turns it has no armour at all, and takes 15% more physical damage from everyone.

enzo_cultist.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is never knowing if it was him. ... a perfect riposte that turns the next attack on him back on its owner.'

ability.name: The Perfect Riposte
ability.engine: live: riposte (new): for 3 turns the next enemy hit on Enzo lands on its owner at 150% and Enzo takes nothing
ability.description: Enzo waits for it. The next attack on him in the next 3 turns misses him completely and lands on whoever threw it, half again as hard.

esteban_bloodmage.from: Wave 4: 'with the party's agreement, he takes some of everyone's health and uses it to save the one who's dying.'

ability.name: With Everyone's Consent
ability.engine: live: a heal on the lowest ally, plus drains_party_pct (new 19 Nov 2026): every other ally gives 10% of their maximum health to them
ability.description: Esteban asks, and everyone agrees. Every other ally, Esteban included, gives 10% of their maximum health to the most wounded one, on top of a heal from him.

fiona_witchhunter.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is evidence used without care. ... she exposes an enemy, stripping its protections, and the party's damage against it is much higher.'

ability.name: Entered Properly This Time
ability.engine: live: debuff that strips every magic buff (cleanses on a hostile target), armour -40% and damage taken +25, 4 turns
ability.description: Fiona lays it all out properly. The enemy loses every magic protection it has, and for 4 turns it has 40% less armour and takes 25% more damage.

freja_priest.from: Wave 4: 'when the whole party is close to falling, she gets one turn where every heal she casts lands twice. The calmest person in the room at the worst moment.'

ability.name: The Calmest Person in the Room
ability.engine: live: healing_done_pct on herself for 2 turns, instant so the heal comes the same turn
ability.description: For 2 turns every heal Freja casts lands twice: her healing is doubled.

gianluca_guardian.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is waiting for them to come back before he builds. ... he talks the enemies into fighting him, taunting every one of them, and his shield holds harder while he talks.'

ability.name: Keeps Them Talking
ability.engine: live: self absorb renewed each turn (absorb_refreshes) and taunts_all, 3 turns
ability.description: Gianluca talks every enemy into coming at him instead. For 3 turns they fight him and nobody else, and his shield is made whole again at the start of each of his turns.

giorgi_primalist.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is walking down to nobody. ... he rings the bell, and every ally who hears it shakes off fear and slows the enemy around them.'

ability.name: Rings the Bell
ability.engine: live: party cc_immune for 3 turns (breaks fear already on them) and enemy_mods haste -30 on every enemy
ability.description: Giorgi rings the bell. Every ally shakes off fear and can't be stunned, feared or charmed for 3 turns, and every enemy acts 30% slower for as long.

graham_warlock.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is fearing his gift is cruel. ... his slow curses on every enemy also heal the party a little each turn.'

ability.name: A Kind Ending
ability.engine: live: shadow DoT on every enemy for 5 turns; each tick heals the party for 30% of it (dot_heals_party_pct)
ability.description: Graham lays a slow curse on every enemy for 5 turns, and every turn it hurts them, it heals each ally for 30% of the damage.

gunnar_barbarian.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the grief he buried. ... he calls on the ancestors with a song, and every ally fights harder while it lasts.'

ability.name: The Old Song
ability.engine: live: party heal over time for 4 turns that carries damage dealt +20 while it runs
ability.description: Gunnar sings the old song for the ones who came before. For 4 turns every ally heals a little each turn and deals 20% more damage.

hana_shaman.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is not accepting "somewhere". ... she pulls the most wounded ally out of danger and heals them to full.'

ability.name: Not Somewhere
ability.engine: live: heals_pct_max 100 on whoever is lowest (auto_lowest_ally)
ability.description: Hana goes in for whoever's worst off. The most wounded ally, whoever was picked, is healed to full health.

haruto_runemaster.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the twenty years of silence, and losing his hand. ... a single perfect rune strike that can't miss, be dodged or be resisted.'

ability.name: Twenty Years in One Line
ability.engine: live: one strike that cannot miss, dodge or parry and ignores all armour
ability.description: One perfect rune stroke. It can't miss, be dodged or be parried, and it ignores all of the target's armour.

hector_witchdoctor.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the fear of losing his name. ... a huge finishing move that slams the enemy and stuns everything near it.'

ability.name: The Finisher
ability.engine: live: shadow spell damage on one enemy row, stunning everything in it for 1 turn
ability.description: Héctor goes to the top rope for the finisher. It slams one enemy row with shadow damage, and everything in that row is stunned for 1 turn.

henrik_mage.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the unfinished calculation. ... he works right at his limit, and his next spells hit far harder.'

ability.name: Right at the Limit
ability.engine: live: self buff, damage dealt +50% and spell crit +15 for 3 turns
ability.description: Henrik stops leaving a margin. For 3 turns his spells deal 50% more damage and have 15% more chance to land a critical hit.

iker_guardian.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the ninety kids he couldn't find. ... he shouts the party back up, and every ally regains health and resource.'

ability.name: Everybody Up
ability.engine: live: party heal plus heals_party_pct_max 10 and party_resource_pct 30 (each ally's own resource)
ability.description: Iker shouts the whole party back up. Every ally is healed, and for a tenth of their maximum on top, and gets back 30% of their mana, rage or energy.

ileana_necromancer.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is the unfinished conversation, and the years of being cold. ... she holds the line for the whole ensemble, freezing every enemy's next action.'

ability.name: Hold the Line, Everyone
ability.engine: live: stun on every enemy for 1 turn (is_stun debuff, all_enemies)
ability.description: Ileana holds the line for the whole ensemble. Every enemy freezes in place for 1 turn and loses its next action.

imelda_primalist.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is never being seen by her mother. ... a combination of strikes where every hit heals the most wounded ally.'

ability.name: The Whole Combination
ability.engine: live: one heavy strike that cannot miss, heals_lowest_ally_pct 100
ability.description: Imelda throws the whole combination at one enemy, and it can't miss. The most wounded ally is healed for all of the damage it deals.

ivan_warrior.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the fear of hitting someone. ... a huge two-handed strike that can't hit an ally even in a crowd, and that stops dead on the enemy.'

ability.name: Stops Dead on It
ability.engine: live: one heavy strike that cannot miss and ignores 40% of armour; single target only
ability.description: A huge two-handed strike that can't miss and ignores 40% of the target's armour. It stops dead on that enemy and never touches anyone else.

joaquin_suncleric.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is carrying it alone. ... he takes a share of every ally's pain into himself, healing them and taking some of the damage.'

ability.name: Carried Together
ability.engine: live: party damage_share 40% to Joaquín for 4 turns, and heals_party_pct_max 15 at once
ability.description: Joaquín takes some of it into himself. Every ally is healed for 15% of their maximum, and for 4 turns he takes 40% of every hit they take.

junseo_reaper.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is moving without choosing. ... he chooses every strike deliberately for a few turns, and each one lands where it hurts most.'

ability.name: Every One Chosen
ability.engine: live: self buff, physical crit +30 and hit +27 for 4 turns
ability.description: Jun-seo chooses every strike. For 4 turns his attacks have 30% more chance to land a critical hit, and he doesn't miss.

karim_felsworn.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is "nobody to grieve". ... he plants himself, and every enemy is pulled to him while his armour holds.'

ability.name: Plants Himself
ability.engine: live: self absorb, armour +40% and taunts_all for 4 turns
ability.description: Karim plants himself. For 4 turns every enemy comes for him and nobody else. He is shielded, and has 40% more armour.

kesten_the_catalogued.from: Wave 4: 'when an ally would die, he writes their name down properly and they hold on at 1 health instead. It fits "a person isn't a number".'

ability.name: Written Down Properly
ability.engine: live: death_prevent on every ally (hp 1, lethal hits only, one use each)
ability.description: For 3 turns, the first blow that would kill each ally leaves them at 1 health instead.

khalid_hunter.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the bird he left behind. ... his bird stoops on the most dangerous enemy, striking hard and blinding it.'

ability.name: The Falcon Comes Back
ability.engine: live: ranged hit that cannot miss on the most dangerous enemy (auto_enemy dangerous), target_mods miss_chance_pct 50 for 3 turns
ability.description: The falcon comes back, and stoops on the most dangerous enemy in the fight. It strikes hard, and for 3 turns that enemy misses half its attacks.

kiet_rogue.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is being invisible. ... he vanishes and reappears behind the most dangerous enemy with a crippling strike.'

ability.name: Out of Nowhere
ability.engine: live: always_crits strike on the most dangerous enemy (auto_enemy dangerous), wipes_threat, target_mods haste -40 and damage dealt -30 for 3 turns
ability.description: Kiet vanishes and comes out behind the most dangerous enemy with a strike that always crits. Every enemy forgets him, and for 3 turns that one acts 40% slower and deals 30% less damage.

kourosh_mage.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is living inside the figure. ... he calculates the enemy's next move exactly, and the party takes far less from it.'

ability.name: Worked Out Exactly
ability.engine: live: debuff on whichever enemy acts next (auto_enemy next): damage dealt -70 for 2 turns, and reveals_intent all
ability.description: Kourosh works out the next move exactly. The enemy about to act deals 70% less damage for 2 turns, and the party sees what every enemy will do.

liam_suncleric.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is going in alone. ... he calls the crew in, and every ally gets a burst of healing at once.'

ability.name: Calls the Crew In
ability.engine: live: party heal, plus heals_party_pct_max 10
ability.description: Liam doesn't go in alone this time. He calls the crew in, and every ally is healed at once, and for a tenth of their maximum health on top.

lucia_suncleric.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is praying alone. ... she prays out loud and every ally's healing is stronger for a few turns.'

ability.name: Out Loud, For Everyone
ability.engine: live: party healing_taken_pct for 4 turns (recipient side, so every heal and every heal over time counts)
ability.description: Lúcia prays out loud, for all of them. For 4 turns every ally receives 40% more healing, from anyone.

luka_stormbringer.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is fearing the storm. ... a maelstrom that pulls every enemy together and batters them.'

ability.name: Into the Storm, Not Away
ability.engine: live: nature spell damage on every enemy, and enemy_mods forced_front for 2 turns (pulled into the front row)
ability.description: Luka steers into the storm. A maelstrom batters every enemy and drags them all into the front row for 2 turns, where anyone can reach them.

marco_paladin.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is putting things off. ... he takes every hit aimed at the party for a turn, and the hits that land on him are much weaker.'

ability.name: Not Putting It Off
ability.engine: live: damage_share 100% to Marco from every ally, halved, for 2 turns
ability.description: For 2 turns every hit aimed at an ally lands on Marco instead, and he takes 50% less from it.

marcus_stormbringer.from: Wave 4: 'when the party is about to take a big hit, he calls it in time and they take far less.'

ability.name: Heard This Time
ability.engine: live: party damage taken -50% for 2 turns, and reveals_intent all
ability.description: Marcus calls it in time, and this time they listen. For 2 turns the party takes 50% less damage and sees every enemy's next move.

marisol_priest.from: Wave 4: 'she talks an ally through it, and they can't fall below a sliver of health for two turns.'

ability.name: Talk Them Through It
ability.engine: live: death_prevent at 5% that catches every blow, not only a lethal one, for 2 turns; holds, so it keeps catching while they sit on the floor
ability.description: Marisol keeps talking. For 2 turns that ally can't be brought below 5% of their health, however hard they're hit.

marta_tinker.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is waiting at the door. ... a charge she sets and leaves, and it goes off later exactly when it'll do the most.'

ability.name: Set It and Walk Away
ability.engine: live: delayed (2 turns, x1.5) fire damage that can't be interrupted
ability.description: Marta sets a charge on an enemy and walks away. At the end of her second turn from now it goes off for 50% more than an ordinary blast of its size, and nothing can stop it or make it miss.

mateo_starcaller.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is choosing the sky over his family. ... he calls down starlight, which damages enemies and heals allies at the same time.'

ability.name: Starlight for Both
ability.engine: live: arcane spell damage on every enemy, plus heals_party_pct_max 12
ability.description: Mateo calls the starlight down on both at once. It strikes every enemy with arcane damage, and heals every ally for 12% of their maximum health.

matias_reaper.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the silence, and the argument with his father. ... he stands in front and takes every hit aimed at the party's weakest member.'

ability.name: Standing in Front of Them
ability.engine: live: damage_share 100% to Matías on the lowest-health ally (auto_lowest_ally), 30% reduced, 3 turns
ability.description: Matías stands in front of whoever is closest to falling. For 3 turns every hit aimed at them lands on him instead, 30% lighter.

minh_chronomancer.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is never handing over control. ... he rewinds the last turn for the whole party, undoing the damage they took.'

ability.name: Everyone, Two Turns Back
ability.engine: live: immediate rewind on every living ally (target_type party)
ability.description: Minh lets go of the clock for all of them at once. Every ally returns to the health they had 2 of their turns ago, if that was more.

nicolas_bloodmage.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the two streets he wasn't there for. ... he bleeds for the whole party, taking a share of every hit they take for a few turns.'

ability.name: There This Time
ability.engine: live: party damage_share 50% to Nicolás, and he heals back 30% of what he pays, 4 turns
ability.description: Nicolás bleeds for all of them. For 4 turns he takes half of every hit on an ally, and heals back 30% of what he pays.

nizar_chronomancer.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the time that wouldn't move. ... he slows every enemy for a few turns while the party acts at full speed.'

ability.name: Time Stands Still for Them
ability.engine: live: all_enemies debuff haste -45 for 4 turns
ability.description: Nizar holds the clock still for everyone but the party. For 4 turns every enemy acts 45% slower.

orlando_witchdoctor.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is not being able to go home. ... a passive where allies near him at the start of a fight are steadier and harder to frighten.'

passives._text: Orlando steadies the room before anything starts. For the first 3 turns of every fight, no ally can be stunned, feared or charmed, and every ally takes 10% less damage.

osvaldo_warlock.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the emptiness. ... he plays one long note, and the party's spells hit harder until it fades.'

ability.name: One Long Note
ability.engine: live: all_enemies debuff magic_damage_taken_pct +35 for 4 turns (every school but physical)
ability.description: Osvaldo plays one long note and holds it. For 4 turns every enemy takes 35% more damage from spells, whoever casts them.

owen_cultist.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the voice, and saying no to it. ... he takes the darkness that would hit the party into himself and holds it.'

ability.name: Holds It, and Says No
ability.engine: live: party damage_share 100% of magic hits only (schools), 40% reduced, 3 turns
ability.description: Owen takes the dark into himself and holds it. For 3 turns every spell that hits an ally lands on him instead, 40% lighter. Steel and claws still land where they're aimed.

pasang_primalist.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the fear of dying alone on the mountain. ... he ropes the party together, so damage to any one of them is shared among all.'

ability.name: Roped Together
ability.engine: live: party damage spread, even (the one hit keeps an equal share), 25% reduced, 4 turns
ability.description: Pasang ropes the party together. For 4 turns a hit on any ally is split evenly across all of them, and the shares carried by the others are 25% lighter.

pavlo_knight.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is believing nothing he taught mattered. ... he holds the line so completely that the party takes no damage for a turn.'

ability.name: Nothing Gets Past
ability.engine: live: party damage taken -100% for 1 turn
ability.description: Pavlo holds the line completely. For 1 turn the party takes no damage at all.

pieter_guardian.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the tenth man. ... he puts up a barrier, and for a few turns no ally can take more than a set amount of damage from one hit.'

ability.name: Nobody Is the Tenth Man
ability.engine: live: party max_hit_pct 15 for 3 turns (no single hit takes more than 15% of maximum health)
ability.description: Pieter puts the barrier up. For 3 turns no single hit can take more than 15% of any ally's maximum health.

ramiro_primalist.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the shift he left underneath. ... he raises stone walls around the party that absorb damage until they crumble.'

ability.name: Nobody Left Underneath
ability.engine: live: party absorb for 5 turns, with armour +25% while it stands
ability.description: Ramiro raises stone walls around every ally. For 5 turns they are shielded until the stone crumbles, and have 25% more armour.

ratih_ranger.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is always being alone. ... she marks the one wrong thing in a fight, and every ally's attacks on it can't miss.'

ability.name: The One Wrong Thing in the Wood
ability.engine: live: debuff sure_target (the party's attacks on it cannot miss) and damage taken +20, 4 turns
ability.description: Ratih marks the one thing in the fight that's wrong. For 4 turns nobody's attacks on it can miss, and it takes 20% more damage.

reka_necromancer.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is fearing she only makes things walk. ... she raises a swarm of crows that strikes every enemy and then scatters harmlessly.'

ability.name: The Crows Go Up
ability.engine: live: shadow spell damage on every enemy, and enemy_mods miss_chance_pct 20 for 2 turns while the crows harry them
ability.description: Réka raises a swarm of crows. They strike every enemy, harry them so they miss 20% of their attacks for 2 turns, and then scatter.

rhys_ranger.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is not knowing. ... Tegan dives on the enemy about to act and stops it.'

ability.name: Tegan Stoops
ability.engine: live: ranged hit on whichever enemy acts next (auto_enemy next), with a 1-turn stun
ability.description: Tegan stoops on whichever enemy is about to act, whoever Rhys was aiming at. It is struck and loses its turn.

rosa_hunter.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is the year she was outclassed and the pride it cost. ... she reads the enemy's next three moves, and the party's attacks can't miss for those turns.'

ability.name: Three Moves Ahead
ability.engine: live: party hit_rating +27 and spell_hit_rating +100 for 3 turns, and reveals_intent all
ability.description: Rosa reads the next three moves. For 3 turns the party sees what every enemy will do next, and nobody's attacks or spells can miss.

rui_cultist.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the thing he gave to the sea. ... a plain, clean healing tide that washes over the whole party, his own and nothing else's.'

ability.name: His Own Tide
ability.engine: live: a plain party heal, no cost to Rui
ability.description: A plain, clean tide of Rui's own, with nothing owed for it. It heals the whole party and costs him nothing but mana.

ryan_warlock.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is hiding from what he did. ... he pays the price himself, taking the damage meant for the party and turning it into power for his demon.'

ability.name: Pays It Himself
ability.engine: live: damage_share 50% to Ryan, 30% lighter, for 3 turns; pet_mods (new 19 Nov 2026) give his demon +40% damage
ability.description: For 3 turns half of every hit on an ally goes to Ryan instead, 30% lighter, and his demon deals 40% more damage.

saoirse_starcaller.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is the girls she couldn't stand in front of. ... she shouts a call, and every ally fights harder for a few turns.'

ability.name: The Call From the Back Line
ability.engine: live: party damage +30% and crit chance +10 (physical and spell) for 3 turns
ability.description: Saoirse shouts the call, the way she should have. For 3 turns every ally deals 30% more damage and has 10% more chance to land a critical hit.

sebastian_bloodmage.from: Wave 4: 'after a rest, the whole party starts the next fight stronger, because they ate properly and so did he.'

ability.name: Everybody Sits Down
ability.engine: live: party damage dealt +25% and damage taken -15% for 5 turns. The profile's idea was a passive after a rest; built as a cast so it works in any fight
ability.description: Everyone eats properly, Sebastián too. For 5 turns the party deals 25% more damage and takes 15% less.

silas_rogue.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is watching and saying nothing. ... he sees an enemy's big attack coming and steps in front of the ally it was meant for.'

ability.name: Says Something This Time
ability.engine: live: damage_share 100% to Silas, 60% lighter, two uses on each ally, for 3 turns
ability.description: Silas sees it coming and steps in. For 3 turns the next 2 attacks aimed at each ally land on him instead, and he takes 60% less from them.

skye_pyromancer.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is the fear of her own fire. ... a controlled burn that hits every enemy and doesn't touch a single ally.'

ability.name: A Controlled Burn
ability.engine: live: fire spell damage on every enemy, and applies_dot_pct 0.3 (one more burn next turn)
ability.description: Skye lets the fire go exactly where she means it to. It burns every enemy and no ally, and smoulders on each of them for another 30% of the hit next turn.

sondre_stormbringer.from: Wave 4: 'he throws everything at the enemies without holding back, and none of it can touch the party.'

ability.name: Nothing Held Back
ability.engine: live: spell damage to every enemy that cannot miss
ability.description: Heavy nature damage to every enemy. It can't miss, and none of it touches the party.

sophia_mage.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is doubting herself, and losing her father. ... she reads the enemy's next spell and turns it back on them.'

ability.name: Read It Back
ability.engine: live: party magic damage taken -40% and a spell-only reflect of 100% (spell_only new 19 Nov 2026)
ability.description: For 2 turns every ally takes 40% less magic damage, and whatever magic still lands is turned back on its caster in full.

stelios_necromancer.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the blank page. ... he raises a fallen enemy to fight for the party for a few turns, and lays it to rest properly afterwards.'

ability.name: Borrowed, and Given Back
ability.engine: live: summon_pet abomination as an extra pet, needs a fallen enemy, laid to rest after 5 of its turns (pet_lifespan)
ability.description: Once an enemy has fallen, Stelios raises it to fight beside the party. After 5 of its turns he lays it to rest properly.

tarek_templar.from: Wave 4: 'He stops searching and lets Omar rest somewhere that lasts. ... something built to last, like a shield on the whole party that holds until it's broken instead of running out with time.'

ability.name: Built to Last
ability.engine: live: party absorb with a fight-long duration, so only breaking it ends it
ability.description: Shields every ally. The shield doesn't wear off with time: it lasts until it's broken or the fight ends.

thiago_paladin.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the family he couldn't reach. ... he promises an ally they won't die today, and that ally can't fall for a few turns.'

ability.name: Not Today, I Promise
ability.engine: live: ally death_prevent hp 1 on every lethal blow (uses 99) for 4 turns, and healing received +30; holds, so every blow is caught
ability.description: Thiago promises an ally they won't die today. For 4 turns no blow can kill them, however many come, and they receive 30% more healing.

tomas_warrior.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is never staying anywhere. ... he braces the party, so for two turns nothing can knock them down, stun them or push them back.'

ability.name: Nothing Falls Over
ability.engine: live: party cc_immune and armour +30% for 2 turns, and death_prevent (hp 1, lethal only, one use each)
ability.description: Tomas braces the whole party. For 2 turns nobody can be stunned, feared or charmed, everyone has 30% more armour, and a blow that would drop one of them leaves them standing on 1 health.

vuk_knight.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the week that wasn't his. ... he stands over the most wounded ally and takes every hit aimed at them.'

ability.name: Stands Over Them
ability.engine: live: damage_share 100% to Vuk on the lowest-health ally (auto_lowest_ally), and he heals back 30% of what he pays, 4 turns
ability.description: Vuk stands over the most wounded ally. For 4 turns every hit aimed at them lands on him, and he heals back 30% of what he takes.

yusuf_venomancer.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the fear behind the certainty. ... an exact dose for every ally, healing each by just what they need.'

ability.name: The Exact Dose
ability.engine: live: party heal of 0 base plus heals_party_pct_max 45: each ally gets back what they're missing, up to 45% of their maximum
ability.description: Yusuf measures a dose for every ally. Each one is healed for exactly what they're missing, up to 45% of their maximum health.

ziad_felsworn.from: Wave 4: 'what he resolves is the arithmetic. ... he spends his own health to heal the party, and the fel pays him back with damage.'

ability.name: The Fel Pays It Back
ability.engine: live: party heal costing 15% of Ziad's maximum health, then self_buff damage dealt +40 for 3 turns
ability.description: Ziad spends 15% of his own health to heal the whole party. The fel pays him back: for 3 turns he deals 40% more damage.

zofia_cultist.from: Wave 4: 'what she resolves is the bargain she made for her grandmother. ... she turns the Cult's corruption back on an enemy, and it spreads to everything near it.'

ability.name: Back Where It Came From
ability.engine: live: shadow DoT on one enemy row for 5 turns
ability.description: Zofia turns the Cult's own corruption back on an enemy, and it spreads to everything in that row, eating at them for 5 turns.
